request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:GUARD

layers.text: Recolour only his skin: the pale skin of his face, ears, shoulders and arms becomes a dull moss green, colour #5f7d3a with #3f5626 shadows: clearly green, a mid-tone, not black, and the face stays clearly visible. Do not touch his helmet, straps or shield. Keep everything else exactly the same: the pot helmet, tusks, eyes, the brown leather straps, the plank shield with its iron rim, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style.
